title: Support · InEgypt
description: Help with InEgypt: contact, reporting a wrong fare or route, restoring a purchase, and answers to common questions.
lead: Questions, a bug, or a wrong fare or route? Write to us; one person reads and answers every mail.

report.h2: Report a wrong fare, route or stop
report.text: Mail us the stop, line or route, the time you searched and what was wrong. We check it against the operator's information and fix the data in a later update.

extra.q: How do I restore my purchase?
extra.a: In the app, go to Settings → Your Plan → Restore Purchases. Use the same Apple ID you bought with.

extra.q: How do I cancel InEgypt Pro?
extra.a: In iOS Settings → your name → Subscriptions → InEgypt. Pro stays on until the end of the period you paid for.

extra.q: How do I change the app language?
extra.a: In the app, go to Settings → Language.

extra.q: How do I turn off analytics?
extra.a: In the app, go to Settings → Help improve InEgypt. Turning it off also deletes anything recorded but not yet sent.
